blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Razon-led Prime Energy Resources Development B.V. said the local market’s only natural gas field has hit its highest delivery in five years after unlocking new gas supply. On Thursday, the group said Malampaya natural gas deliveries recently reached a five-year high, surging to 400 million standard cubic feet per day. READ: Prime Energy eyes first gas from new Malampaya wells by Q4 This follows the gas project’s successful capacity expansion after activating new wells from Malampaya Phase 4.
